content.title: Thomas Markle Indicted for Possessing Child Sex Abuse Images
content.caption: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, has been indicted by a federal grand jury in Los Angeles for possessing child sex abuse images.

slides.heading: Thomas Markle Indicted for Possessing Child Sex Abuse Images
slides.text: Thomas Markle, the father of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex, has been indicted by a federal grand jury in Los Angeles for possessing child sex abuse images.

slides.heading: Details
slides.text: Thomas Markle, 82, was arrested on November 6th in Florida for possessing child sex abuse images. The FBI found 35mm film negatives containing child sexual abuse materials in his storage unit in Los Angeles.
slides.image_search_query: Thomas Markle storage unit United States

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: Markle is expected to be arraigned in Los Angeles in the coming weeks. He is facing two counts of possessing child sexual abuse materials.
